facts.fact: The Information Regulator issued an enforcement notice on 22 May 2026 under section 77J(1)(a) of PAIA directing Sibanye-Stillwater to grant a complainant access to compliance reports, after a complaint lodged on 15 September 2023 and an investigation report.
